bonuses.name: Iron Soul
bonuses.text: This Threat is unaffected by abilities that target the mind, and never needs to make a Resolve Test to continue fighting.

bonuses.name: Assistant
bonuses.text: Any Elite or Adversary ally within 10m of the Servo-Skull gains +2 bonus dice to all Skill Tests.

options.name: Gun-Skull
options.text: Some Servo-Skulls are upgraded to Gun-Skulls armed with pistol weapons. A Laspistol is the most common armament.

options.name: Dissector-Skull
options.text: A few Servo-Skulls are equipped with medical or interrogation tools, suited for close combat if necessary.
